subStrands.name: Store Management, Functions and Establishment Factors

objectives.description: Store Management: meaning; importance; functions of a store manager; characteristics of a store manager; customer services (pre-sale and after-sale services).
Functions of Management: planning, organisation, leading, staffing, controlling.
Factors to be considered in establishing a store: market, finance, types of stock, transport, accessibility, security, government regulation and personnel.

subStrands.name: Retailing, Wholesaling, Warehousing, Transportation and Stock Control

objectives.description: Retailing: definition; functions of a retailer. Wholesaling: definition; functions of a wholesaler. Warehousing: meaning; types; importance. Transportation: definition; means; advantages and disadvantages; factors determining choice of transport.
Introduction to Stock Control: meaning; importance; types of stock records (stock list, bin card/store card, store requisition form, delivery notes).
Methods of Stock Control: manual (periodic, perpetual and annual stock taking) and computerised; levels of stock control (maximum, minimum, reorder level); issuing of stock (FIFO and LIFO).
Pricing: definition; types (skimming, mark-up, mark-down, penetration, below or above mark pricing).

subStrands.name: Organisational Policy, Standards, Culture and Communication

objectives.description: Organisational Policy: definition; employment policy; decision on customer services and public relations. Organisational Standards: definition; productivity standards; standards for customer satisfaction. Organisational Culture: definition; explanation.
Communication: definition; means (fax, telephone, email, radio messages); word processing — using computer to write business letters.

subStrands.name: Business Law, Regulatory Agencies and Record Keeping

objectives.description: Business Law: overview — definition; law of contract (elements, rights and obligations of employer and employee); agency (definition, types, creation, rights and obligations of principals/agents); sale of goods act (contract of sale, formalities).
Government Regulation and Regulatory Agencies: patent right, copyright, trade mark; health and safety at work act; consumer protection agency; licence; NAFDAC, NDLEA, SON.

Record Keeping: documentation — filing/indexing (definition, rules, methods); source documents (meaning, types); trade documents — documents used in foreign trade (bills of lading, certificate of origin, consular invoice, insurance certificate, bill of exchange, letter of credit) and home trade.

subStrands.name: Bookkeeping, Risk Management and Handling Store Finances

objectives.description: Bookkeeping: subsidiary books (meaning, types, uses, purchase and sales day book, returns books, cash books); imprest system (definition, preparation of petty cash book); final accounts (trading, profit and loss account, balance sheet); sales/turnover (meaning, calculation of rate of sales turnover).
Risk Management: definition; methods — sound management practices, reduction of risks (optimum stock level), hedging, risk transfer through insurance.

Handling Finances of the Store: investments — capital investment (investment in capital market, functions of stock exchange, advantages of shareholding); money market instruments (treasury bill, commercial papers, bonds). Taxation: meaning, importance, types (income tax, import duties, excise duties, VAT).
